sections.title: The same word, a bigger idea
sections.content: You already know negyed as "quarter" from telling time — negyed óra, a quarter hour. It's the same word here, describing a quarter of a city instead of a quarter of a clock: a district, a named part of town with its own character.

items.spanish: A negyedben van egy templom és egy park is.
items.english: In the district there's a church and a park too.

sections.content: English does the same double duty with "quarter" — a quarter hour and a city's Latin Quarter both come from the same idea of a fourth part. Hungarian just reuses negyed the same natural way.
